name: akeeba/s3
description: A compact, dependency-less Amazon S3 API client implementing the most commonly used features

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit tests, then the integration tests against every environment in .env.test (if any)
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the unit tests. No network, no S3 account
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration suite against each environment in .env.test. Options: --env=A,B --quick --no-big-files --no-multipart --no-2100 --list -- <phpunit args>
scripts-descriptions.test:garage: Start Garage in Docker, run the integration suite against it, stop it
scripts-descriptions.garage:up: Start the Garage container with the test bucket and access key
scripts-descriptions.garage:down: Stop the Garage container and delete its data
